title: Bundle standard - 1120
content: TCP/IP - id:1120 RFC 9293 TCP RFC 9293 TCP Specifies the TCP (TCP). TCP is an important transport-layer proto in the Internet proto stack, and it has continuously evolved over decades of use and growth of the Internet. Over this time, a number of changes have been made to TCP as it was specified in RFC 793, though these have only been documented in a piecemeal fashion. This document collects and brings those changes together with the proto specification from RFC 793. This document obsoletes RFC 793, as well as RFCs 879, 2873, 6093, 6429, 6528, and 6691 that updated parts of RFC 793. It updates RFCs 1011 and 1122, and it should be considered as a replacement for the portions of those documents dealing with TCP requirements. It also updates RFC 5961 by adding a small clarification in reset handling while in the SYN-RECEIVED state. The TCP header control bits from RFC 793 have also been updated based on RFC 3168. content: EFC CEN-DSRC Management Layer - id:1155 CEN 13372 RTTT DSRC - Profiles CEN 13372 Road Transport and Traffic Telematics (RTTT) - Dedicated short-range comm - Profiles for RTTT applications This European Standard spec DSRC profiles which provide coherent sets of comm tools for applications based on DSRC. These sets consist of subsets of functionality described in prEN 12253, EN 12795 and EN 12834, out of which a minimum subset is mandatory. The DSRC Standards prEN 12253, EN 12795 and EN 12834, which together form a three-layered arch for DSRC, are designed to encompass a wide range of services for different purposes in order to make the basic DSRC arch suited for many different applications and for a wide range of possible products and systems. DSRC systems can be built using one-way (downlink) or two-way (interactive) communication. The DSRC profiles described in this European Standard are intended for interactive DSRC systems based on two-way comm and DSRC systems using one-way comm (broadcast services). While prEN 12253 contains very little variation, EN 12795 and especially EN 12834 describe a wide range of comm services. It has not been considered feasible to assume that any one piece of equipment is designed to implement all of these services. It is often the case that the functionality of the on board unit is more limited than the functionality of the roadside unit. This European Standard covers - Physical Layer parameter values - Data Link Layer subsets - Application Layer subsets - Initialisation procedures - Late response procedures - Termination procedures

title: Bundle standard - 52
content: NTCIP TP-Internet - id:52 IPv4 IAB STD 5 Internet Protocol A bundle of standards (RFCs) that define how IPv4 works RFC 768 UDP RFC 768 UDP RFC def a connectionless, low bandwidth Transport Layer that is typically used with IP. RFC 9293 TCP RFC 9293 TCP Specifies the TCP (TCP). TCP is an important transport-layer proto in the Internet proto stack, and it has continuously evolved over decades of use and growth of the Internet. Over this time, a number of changes have been made to TCP as it was specified in RFC 793, though these have only been documented in a piecemeal fashion. This document collects and brings those changes together with the proto specification from RFC 793. This document obsoletes RFC 793, as well as RFCs 879, 2873, 6093, 6429, 6528, and 6691 that updated parts of RFC 793. It updates RFCs 1011 and 1122, and it should be considered as a replacement for the portions of those documents dealing with TCP requirements. It also updates RFC 5961 by adding a small clarification in reset handling while in the SYN-RECEIVED state. The TCP header control bits from RFC 793 have also been updated based on RFC 3168.

title: MaineDOT Statewide TMC
content:
Element Name: MaineDOT Statewide TMC Description: The MaineDOT Communications Center (Radio Room) monitors and controls traffic and the road network 24/7. It manages a broad range of transportation facilities including freeway systems, rural and suburban highway systems, and urban and suburban traffic control systems. These systems communicate with the MaineDOT Field Devices to monitor and manage traffic flow and monitor the condition of the roadway, surrounding environmental conditions, and field equipment status. The Radio Room will eventually assume the functionality of a statewide TOC.

Incidents are detected, verified, and incident info is provided to responders and motorists (through highway advisory radio and dynamic message signs), and info service providers. The MaineDOT Communications Center also initiates ROSS and VSL in response to road and weather conditions. 

The Communications Center also manages traffic and transportation resources to support allied agencies in responding to, and recovering from, incidents ranging from minor traffic incidents through major disasters.

The Communications Center communicates with other traffic mgmt centers to coordinate traffic info and control strategies in neighboring jurisdictions. It coordinates with the MaineDOT maintenance systems to maintain the road network and coordinate and adapt to maintenance activities, closures, and detours. title: Maine Turnpike Toll Administration Center
content: Element Name: Maine Turnpike Toll Administration Center Description: The Maine Turnpike Toll Administration Center provides general payment administration capabilities and supports the electronic transfer of authenticated funds from the customer. This center supports traveler enrollment and collection of both pre-payment and post-payment transportation fees in coordination with the financial infrastructure supporting electronic payment transactions. The center communications with the Turnpike`s toll plazas to support fee collection operations. The system also sets and administers the pricing structures. title: Maine Turnpike Toll Plazas
content: Element Name: Maine Turnpike Toll Plazas Description: Maine Turnpike toll plazas provide the capability for vehicle operators to pay tolls without stopping their vehicles using Turnpike determined pricing structures and includes the capability to implement various variable road pricing policies. Each transaction is accompanied by feedback to the customer indicating the general status of the customer account. A record of the transactions is provided to the Turnpike`s Toll Administration Center for reconciliation and so that the customer can periodically receive a detailed record of the transactions. title: intersection geometry
content: Flow Overview Flow Name intersection geometry Description The physical geometry of an intersection covering the location and width of each approaching lane, egress lane, and valid paths between approaches and egresses. This flow also def the location of stop lines, cross walks, specific traffic law restrictions for the intersection (e.g., turning movement restrictions), and other elements that support calculation of a safe and legal vehicle path through the intersection.

title: traffic detector control
content: Flow Overview Flow Name traffic detector control Description Information used to configure and control traffic detector systems such as inductive loop detectors and machine vision sensors.

title: wrong way vehicle detected
content: Flow Overview Flow Name wrong way vehicle detected Description Notification that a vehicle has been detected traveling in the wrong direction. This can be a direct report by an equipped vehicle that is being driven in the wrong direction or a report of a non-equipped vehicle that has been detected traveling in the wrong direction. It includes the current location, speed, acceleration, and heading of the wrong way vehicle.

title: traffic detector data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name traffic detector data Description Raw and/or processed traffic detector data which allows derivation of traffic flow variables (e.g., speed, volume, and density measures) and associated info (e.g., congestion, potential incidents). This flow includes the traffic data and the operational status of the traffic detectors

title: traffic images
content: Flow Overview Flow Name traffic images Description High fidelity, real-time traffic images suitable for surveillance monitoring by the operator or for use in machine vision applications. This flow includes the images. Meta data that describes the images is contained in another flow.

title: roadway advisory radio data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name roadway advisory radio data Description Information used to initialize, configure, and control roadside highway advisory radio. This flow can provide message content and delivery attributes, local message store maintenance requests, control mode commands, status queries, and all other commands and associated parameters that support remote mgmt of these systems.

title: roadway advisory radio status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name roadway advisory radio status Description Current operating status of highway advisory radios.

title: incident scene images
content: Flow Overview Flow Name incident scene images Description Real time images or video of an incident scene. This flow includes the images or video and meta data that describes the images.

title: traffic metering control
content: Flow Overview Flow Name traffic metering control Description Control commands and operating parameters for ramp meters, interchange meters, mainline meters, and other systems equipment associated with roadway metering operations.

title: commercial vehicle location data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name commercial vehicle location data Description Current vehicle location and related operational conditions data provided by a commercial vehicle.

title: traffic metering status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name traffic metering status Description Current operational status and operating parameters for ramp meters, interchange meters, mainline meters and other control equipment associated with roadway metering operations.

title: speed monitoring control
content: Flow Overview Flow Name speed monitoring control Description Information used to configure and control automated speed monitoring, speed warning, and speed enforcement systems.

title: parking area management information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name parking area mgmt info Description Parameters that support mgmt of a parking area. Hours of operation, parking rules and regulations, parking operator (attendant) information, etc.

title: parking area information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name parking area info Description Current status for the parking area. This includes info on general parking area status (operating hours, open entrances and exits, entrance queue status, parking operator information, current parking occupancy and availability).

title: parking area transit information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name parking area transit info Description Predicted and actual arrival times at the parking area and services offered by arriving transit vehicles.

title: parking area arrival information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name parking area arrival info Description Detailed arrival info within a parking area and area entrances available for transit use.

title: roadway dynamic signage data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name roadway dynamic signage data Description Information used to initialize, configure, and control dynamic message signs. This flow can provide message content and delivery attributes, local message store maintenance requests, control mode commands, status queries, and all other commands and associated parameters that support remote mgmt of these devices.

title: roadway dynamic signage status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name roadway dynamic signage status Description Current operating status of dynamic message signs.

title: video surveillance control
content: Flow Overview Flow Name video surveillance control Description Information used to configure and control video surveillance systems.

title: parking payment instructions
content: Flow Overview Flow Name parking payment instructions Description Information provided to configure and support parking payment operations including pricing information, user account information, and operational parameters used to control equipment that controls access, collects payment, and detects and processes violations.

title: parking payment transactions
content: Flow Overview Flow Name parking payment transactions Description Detailed list of parking payment transactions including violations. Each transaction includes the date/time, vehicle/customer, and transaction amount. Additional info is included to support delayed payment and violation processing.

title: speed monitoring information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name speed monitoring info Description System status including current operational state and logged info including measured speeds, warning messages displayed, and violation records.

title: trip status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name trip status Description Current location of traveler in the context of a pre-established trip; may include traveler-provided modifications to that route.

title: lane management control
content: Flow Overview Flow Name lane mgmt control Description Information used to configure and control dynamic lane mgmt systems.

title: lane management information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name lane mgmt info Description System status of managed lanes including current operational state, violations, and logged information. This includes lane usage info including both traditional traffic flow measures and special info associated with managed lanes such as measured passenger occupancies. It also includes the operational status of the lane mgmt equipment.

title: guidance updates
content: Flow Overview Flow Name guidance updates Description Information provided to support route guidance that is responsive to current traffic and road conditions. This includes measures of link impedances/delays that can impact routing choices and routing alternatives.

title: border credentials application_ud

title: border credentials status_ud

title: clearance notification_ud

title: driver registration_ud

title: maint and constr work plans_ud

title: vehicle environmental data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name vehicle environmental data Description Data from vehicle safety and convenience systems that can be used to estimate environmental and infrastructure conditions, including measured air temperature, exterior light status, wiper status, sun sensor status, rain sensor status, traction control status, anti-lock brake status, vertical acceleration and other collected vehicle system status and sensor information. The collected data is reported along with the location, heading, and time that the data was collected. Both current data and snapshots of recent events (e.g., traction control or anti-lock brake system activations) may be reported.

title: road network environmental situation data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name road network environmental situation data Description Aggregated environmental situation data collected from vehicles and other sources for the road network. Aggregated info would include measured air temperature, exterior light status, wiper status, sun sensor status, rain sensor status, traction control status, ALB status, and other collected vehicle system status and sensor info for the region.

title: environmental sensor data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name environmental sensor data Description Current road conditions (e.g., surface temperature, subsurface temperature, moisture, icing, treatment status) and surface weather conditions (e.g., air temperature, wind speed, precipitation, visibility) as measured and reported by fixed and/or mobile environmental sensors. Operational status of the sensors is also included.

title: environmental sensor control
