title: road weather advisories
content: Flow Overview Flow Name road weather advisories Description Segment-specific weather and road conditions including real-time advisories of deteriorating road and weather conditions, medium-term advisories for the next 2-12 hours, and long-term advisories more than 12 hours into the future. The advisories may include advisories that are issued based on locally collected environmental data (e.g., an ice on bridge advisory).

title: road weather information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name road weather info Description Road conditions and weather info that are made available by road maintenance operations to other transportation system operators.

title: weather information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name weather info Description Accumulated forecasted and current weather data (e.g., temperature, pressure, wind speed, wind direction, humidity, precipitation, visibility, light conditions, etc.).

title: transportation weather information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transportation weather info Description Current and forecast road conditions and weather info (e.g., surface condition, flooding, wind advisories, visibility, etc.) associated with the transportation network. This info is of a resolution, timeliness, and accuracy to be useful in transportation decision making.

title: road network conditions
content: Flow Overview Flow Name road network conditions Description Current and forecasted traffic information, road and weather conditions, and other road network status. Either raw data, processed data, or some combination of both may be provided by this flow. Information on diversions and alternate routes, closures, and special traffic restrictions (lane/shoulder use, weight restrictions, width restrictions, HOV requirements) in effect is included.

title: transit vehicle loading data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit vehicle loading data Description Data collected on board the transit vehicle relating to passenger boarding and alighting.

title: current infrastructure restrictions
content: Flow Overview Flow Name current infrastructure restrictions Description Restrictions levied on transportation asset usage based on infrastructure design, surveys, tests, or analyses. This includes std facility design height, width, and weight restrictions, special restrictions such as spring weight restrictions, and temporary facility restrictions that are imposed during maintenance and construction.

title: mixed use crossing status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name mixed use crossing status Description Current pedestrian and other mixed use crossing info including an indication of whether the call button has been activated, the current state of the mixed use crossing signal, and info indicating whether non-motorized users are currently occupying the cross walk.

title: intersection status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name intersection status Description Current signal phase and timing info for all lanes at a signalized intersection. This flow identifies active lanes and lanes that are being stopped and spec the length of time that the current state will persist for each lane. It also identifies signal priority and preemption status and pedestrian crossing status info where applicable.

title: work zone warning
content: Flow Overview Flow Name work zone warning Description Warnings provided to field personnel, indicating a work zone emergency or safety issue such as the intrusion of a vehicle into the work zone area or movement of personnel into the travel lanes.

title: work zone warning status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name work zone warning status Description Status of a work zone safety monitoring and warning devices. This flow documents system activations and includes additional supporting info (e.g., an image) that allows verification of the alarm.

title: work zone status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name work zone status Description Current work zone status including current location (and future locations for moving work zones), impact to the roadway, required lane shifts, expected time(s) and duration of impact, anticipated delays, alternate routes, and suggested speed limits.

title: work zone information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name work zone info Description Summary of maintenance and construction work zone activities affecting the road network including the nature of the maintenance or construction activity, location, impact to the roadway, expected time(s) and duration of impact, anticipated delays, alternate routes, and suggested speed limits. This info may be augmented with images that provide a visual indication of current work zone status and traffic impacts.

title: broadcast traveler information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name broadcast traveler info Description General traveler info that contains traffic and road conditions, link travel times, incidents, advisories, restrictions, vehicle requirements, work zones, transit service information, weather information, parking information, and other related traveler information.

title: vehicle control event
content: Flow Overview Flow Name vehicle control event Description Notification that the vehicle has performed an emergency maneuver or action that could impact the safety of surrounding vehicles. This includes hard braking and activation of traction/stability control systems or other actions that warrant immediate notification of surrounding vehicles. The info flow conveys the current vehicle location, path, and current control actions. This may also include the list of maneuvers includes lane changes/departures and overtaking/passing maneuvers.

title: mixed use safety warning status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name mixed use safety warning status Description Current operational status and state of pedestrian crossings and other mixed use path crossing warning systems.

title: track status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name track status Description Current status of the wayside equipment and notification of an arriving train.

title: intersection safety application status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name intersection safety application status Description Infrastructure safety application status reported by the RSE. This includes current operational state and status of the RSE and a record of intersection safety issues identified and alerts and warnings issued.

title: infrastructure restriction warning control
content: Flow Overview Flow Name infrastructure restriction warning control Description Information used to configure and control infrastructure-based sensors that measure the size and weight of passing vehicles and associated signage that provides infrastructure restriction advisories and warnings to drivers.

title: infrastructure restriction warning status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name infrastructure restriction warning status Description Infrastructure restriction warning application status reported by field equipment. This includes current operational state and status of the field equipment and a record of measured vehicle dimensions and alerts and warnings issued.

title: personal crossing safety information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name personal crossing safety info Description Current crossing status including permission to cross, crossing time remaining, and warnings in the event that a vehicle reports an imminent intersection infringement that may impact non-motorized users including pedestrians and cyclists.

title: fleet to driver update
content: Flow Overview Flow Name fleet to driver update Description Updated instructions to the driver including dispatch, routing, travel and parking information, and special instructions. Special instructions include incident mgmt instruction, operational tasks, impacted transport orders in case of an incident, task descriptions with trip/route/load plan, transport order status information, driver information, vehicle information, cargo info and trip information.

title: mixed use safety warning control
content: Flow Overview Flow Name mixed use safety warning control Description Configuration and control of equipment that monitors and manages mixed use crossings and provides visual displays and warnings to drivers when non-motorized users are occupying a cross walk or other mixed use path crossing.

title: personal location
content: Flow Overview Flow Name personal location Description The current location (latitude, longitude, and elevation) reported by the personal info or safety device

title: intersection safety warning
content: Flow Overview Flow Name intersection safety warning Description A warning of an imminent unsafe vehicle infringement at an intersection that may endanger other vehicles or pedestrians. This allows vehicles approaching the intersection to be warned in the event of an imminent red light or stop sign violation or potential infringement on an occupied crosswalk. All connected vehicles and personal devices near the intersection receive the warning.

title: personal location information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name personal location info Description Pedestrian, bicyclist, and other non-motorized user locations at an intersection as detected and reported by an RSE.

title: rail crossing status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name rail crossing status Description Status of the highway-rail intersection equipment including both the current state or mode of operation and the current equipment condition.

title: rail crossing request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name rail crossing request Description A request for highway-rail intersection status or a specific control request intended to modify HRI operation.

title: rail crossing control data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name rail crossing control data Description Data required for HRI info transmitted at railroad grade crossings and within railroad operations.

title: rail crossing operational status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name rail crossing operational status Description Status of the highway-rail grade crossing equipment including both the current state or mode of operation and the current equipment condition.

title: signal control status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name signal control status Description Operational and status data of traffic signal control equipment including operating condition and current indications.

title: intersection safety application info
content: Flow Overview Flow Name intersection safety application info Description Intersection and device configuration data, including intersection geometry, and warning parameters and thresholds. This flow also supports remote control of the application so the application can be taken offline, reset, or restarted.

title: event plans
content: Flow Overview Flow Name event plans Description Plans for major events possibly impacting traffic.

title: transit and fare schedules
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit and fare schedules Description Transit service info including routes, schedules, and fare information.  This also includes on-demand service information.

title: payment request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name payment request Description Request for payment from financial institution or related financial service requests (e.g., balance inquiry)

title: settlement
content: Flow Overview Flow Name settlement Description Information exchanged to settle charges and distribute or debit accounts appropriate to the authorized charges.

title: registration
content: Flow Overview Flow Name registration Description Registered owner of vehicle and associated vehicle information.

title: actuate secure payment
content: Flow Overview Flow Name actuate secure payment Description Initiation of a payment action, ideally based on an encrypted token or biometric marker. Such a payment action could be a simple validation that the secure token allows the user access to the travel resource, or it could be the initiation of a payment transaction.

title: request for payment
content: Flow Overview Flow Name request for payment Description Request to deduct cost of service from user`s payment account.

title: payment instructions
content: Flow Overview Flow Name payment instructions Description Information provided to configure and support fixed point payment operations including pricing information, user account information, and operational parameters used to control equipment that controls access, collects payment, and detects and processes violations.

title: payment transactions
content: Flow Overview Flow Name payment transactions Description Detailed list of transactions including violations. Each transaction includes the date/time, vehicle/customer, and transaction amount. Additional info is included to support delayed payment and violation processing.

title: device data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name device data Description Data from detectors, environmental sensor stations, roadside equipment, and traffic control devices, including device inventory information.

title: device status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name device status Description Status info from devices

title: signal control commands
content: Flow Overview Flow Name signal control commands Description Control of traffic signal controllers or field masters including clock synchronization.

title: signal control device configuration
content: Flow Overview Flow Name signal control device configuration Description Data used to configure traffic signal control equipment including local controllers and system masters.

title: signal control plans
content: Flow Overview Flow Name signal control plans Description Traffic signal timing parameters including minimum green time and interval durations for basic operation and cycle length, splits, offset, phase sequence, etc. for coordinated systems.

title: signal system configuration
content: Flow Overview Flow Name signal system configuration Description Data used to configure traffic signal systems including configuring control sections and mode of operation (time based or traffic responsive).

title: intersection management application info
content: Flow Overview Flow Name intersection mgmt application info Description Intersection and device configuration data, including intersection geometry, and warning parameters and thresholds. This flow also supports remote control of the application so the application can be taken offline, reset, or restarted.

title: electric charging station information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name electric charging station info Description Information provided for electric charging stations identifying the location, operating hours, current availability, charging capacity and standards supported, access restrictions, and rates/fee structure.

title: electric charging services inventory
content: Flow Overview Flow Name electric charging services inventory Description Information provided for electric charging stations identifying the location, operating hours, current availability, charging capacity and standards supported, access restrictions, and rates/fee structure.

title: incident information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name incident info Description Notification of existence of incident and expected severity, location, time and nature of incident. As additional info is gathered and the incident evolves, updated incident info is provided. Incidents include any event that impacts transportation system operation ranging from routine incidents (e.g., disabled vehicle at the side of the road) through large-scale natural or human-caused disasters that involve loss of life, injuries, extensive property damage, and multi-jurisdictional response. This also includes special events, closures, and other planned events that may impact the transportation system.

title: trip request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name trip request Description Request for trip planning services that identifies the trip origin, destination(s), timing, preferences, and constraints. The request may also include the requestor`s location or a request for transit and parking reservations, electric charging station access, and ridesharing options associated with the trip. The trip request also covers requests to revise a previously planned trip and interim updates that are provided as the trip is interactively planned.

title: speed management information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name speed mgmt info Description Target speeds, speed advisories, and/or speed limit info provided to a vehicle. The info includes the current speed value(s), the route segment(s) and lane(s) where the speeds apply, and an indication of whether the speeds are suggested target speeds, posted advisory speeds, or enforceable speed limit values. This flow may also include info about the reason for reduced speeds and provide target lane info if lane changes are required.

title: lighting system control data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name lighting system control data Description Information used to configure and control roadside lighting systems.

title: lighting system status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name lighting system status Description Status of roadside lighting controls including operating condition and current operational state.

title: local signal preemption request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name local signal preemption request Description Direct control signal or message to a signalized intersection that results in preemption of the current control plan and grants right-of-way to the requesting vehicle.

title: local signal priority request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name local signal priority request Description Request from a vehicle to a signalized intersection for priority at that intersection. This flow also allows the vehicle to cancel a priority request (for example, when the vehicle clears the intersection).

title: right-of-way request notification
content: Flow Overview Flow Name right-of-way request notification Description Notice that a request has occurred for signal prioritization, signal preemption, pedestrian call, multi-modal crossing activation, or other source for right-of-way.

title: emergency vehicle tracking data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name emergency vehicle tracking data Description The current location and operating status of the emergency vehicle.

title: suggested route
content: Flow Overview Flow Name suggested route Description Suggested route for a dispatched emergency or maintenance vehicle that may reflect current network conditions and the additional routing options available to en route emergency or maintenance vehicles that are not available to the general public.

title: emergency traffic control request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name emergency traffic control request Description Special request to preempt the current traffic control strategy in effect at one or more signalized intersections or highway segments, activate traffic control and closure systems such as gates and barriers, activate safeguard systems, or use driver info systems. For example, this flow can request all signals to red-flash, request a progression of traffic control preemptions along an emergency vehicle route, request a specific evacuation traffic control plan, request activation of a road closure barrier system, or place a public safety or emergency-related message on a dynamic message sign.

title: emergency traffic control information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name emergency traffic control info Description Status of a special traffic control strategy or system activation implemented in response to an emergency traffic control request, a request for emergency access routes, a request for evacuation, a request to activate closure systems, a request to employ driver info systems to support public safety objectives, or other special requests. Identifies the selected traffic control strategy and system control status.

title: driver to fleet request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name driver to fleet request Description Requests from the driver and vehicle for routing, payment, and enrollment information.

title: transit schedule information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit schedule info Description Current and projected transit schedule info used to initialize the transit vehicle with a vehicle assignment, monitor schedule performance, and develop corrective actions on-board.

title: traffic control priority request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name traffic control priority request Description Request for signal priority at one or more intersections along a particular route.

title: traffic control priority status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name traffic control priority status Description Status of signal priority request functions at the roadside (e.g., enabled or disabled).

title: device control request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name device control request Description Request for device control action

title: transit system data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit system data Description Current transit system operations info indicating current transit routes and fares, the level of service on each route, and the progress of individual vehicles along their routes for use in forecasting demand and estimating current transportation network performance.

title: signal service request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name signal service request Description A call for service or extension for a signal control phase that is issued by the RSE for connected vehicles approaching an intersection and/or pedestrians at a crosswalk. This flow identifies the desired phase and service time.

title: personal signal service request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name personal signal service request Description A request for right of way from a personal device that indicates the type of traveler (pedestrian, special needs pedestrian, bicyclist, etc.), anticipated time of arrival, travel path, and crossing duration.

title: roadway warning system control
content: Flow Overview Flow Name roadway warning system control Description Information used to configure and control roadway warning systems.

title: roadway warning system status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name roadway warning system status Description Current operating status of roadway warning systems.

title: roadway maintenance status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name roadway maintenance status Description Summary of maintenance fleet operations affecting the road network. This includes the status of winter maintenance (snow plow schedule and current status).

title: maint and constr work plans
content: Flow Overview Flow Name maint and constr work plans Description Future construction and maintenance work schedules and activities including anticipated closures with anticipated impact to the roadway, alternate routes, anticipated delays, closure times, and durations.

title: transportation operational strategies
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transportation operational strategies Description Operational strategies for each operating agency in a transportation corridor, downtown area, or other travel-impacted area, providing an integrated operations strategy for the freeways, tollways, arterials, transit services, parking facilities, and other transportation-related facilities in the area. These strategies can include dynamic adjustments to transit fares and tolls, parking fees and restrictions, dynamic lane restriction changes, and other active demand mgmt strategies.

title: transit incident information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit incident info Description Information on transit incidents that impact transit services for public dissemination.

title: incident report
content: Flow Overview Flow Name incident report Description Report of an identified incident including incident location, type, severity and other info necessary to initiate an appropriate incident response.

title: evacuation information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name evacuation info Description Evacuation instructions and info including evacuation zones, evacuation times, and reentry times.

title: emergency traveler information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name emergency traveler info Description Public notification of an emergency such as a natural or man-made disaster, civil emergency, or child abduction. This flow also includes evacuation info including evacuation instructions, evacuation zones, recommended evacuation times, tailored evacuation routes and destinations, traffic and road conditions along the evacuation routes, traveler services and shelter information, and reentry times and instructions.

title: emergency traveler information request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name emergency traveler info request Description Request for alerts, evacuation information, and other emergency info provided to the traveling public.

title: transportation system status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transportation system status Description Current status and condition of transportation infrastructure (e.g., tunnels, bridges, interchanges, TMC offices, maintenance facilities). In case of disaster or major incident, this flow provides an assessment of damage sustained by the surface transportation system including location and extent of the damage, estimate of remaining capacity and necessary restrictions, and time frame for repair and recovery.

title: emergency transit schedule information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name emergency transit schedule info Description Information on transit schedule and service changes that adapt the service to better meet needs of responders and the general public in an emergency situation, including special service schedules supporting evacuation.

title: emergency plan coordination
content: Flow Overview Flow Name emergency plan coordination Description Information that supports coordination of emergency mgmt plans, continuity of operations plans, emergency response and recovery plans, evacuation plans, and other emergency plans between agencies. This includes general plans that are coordinated prior to an incident and shorter duration tactical plans that are prepared during an incident.

title: emergency transit service request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name emergency transit service request Description Request to modify transit service and fare schedules to address emergencies, including requests for transit services to evacuate people from and/or deploy response agency personnel to an emergency scene. The request may poll for resource availability or request pre-staging, staging, or immediate dispatch of transit resources.

title: emergency transit service response
content: Flow Overview Flow Name emergency transit service response Description Response indicating changes to transit service, fares, and/or restrictions that will be made and status of transit resources to be deployed to support emergency response and/or evacuation.

title: road network status assessment
content: Flow Overview Flow Name road network status assessment Description Assessment of damage sustained by the road network including location and extent of the damage, estimate of remaining capacity, required closures, alternate routes, necessary restrictions, and time frame for repair and recovery.

title: emergency route request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name emergency route request Description Request for access routes for emergency response vehicles and equipment. This may be a request for ingress or egress routes or other emergency routes.  It may also include a request for preemption/priority for the identified vehicle at all signalized intersections along the route.

title: emergency routes
content: Flow Overview Flow Name emergency routes Description Suggested ingress and egress routes for access to and between the scene and staging areas or other specialized emergency access routes.

title: decision support information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name decision support info Description Information provided to support effective and safe incident response, including local traffic, road, and weather conditions, hazardous material information, and the current status of resources (including vehicles, other equipment, supplies) that have been allocated to an incident.

title: emergency dispatch requests
content: Flow Overview Flow Name emergency dispatch requests Description Emergency vehicle dispatch instructions including incident location and available info concerning the incident.

title: emergency dispatch response
content: Flow Overview Flow Name emergency dispatch response Description Request for additional emergency dispatch info and provision of en route status.

title: incident scene status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name incident scene status Description Information gathered at the incident site that more completely characterizes the incident and provides current incident response status.

title: incident information for public
content: Flow Overview Flow Name incident info for public Description Report of current desensitized incident info prepared for public dissemination.

title: demand responsive transit request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name demand responsive transit request Description Request for paratransit support.

title: demand responsive transit plan
content: Flow Overview Flow Name demand responsive transit plan Description Plan regarding overall demand responsive transit schedules and deployment.

title: user profile
content: Flow Overview Flow Name user profile Description Information provided to register for a travel service and create a user account. The provided info includes personal identification, traveler preferences (e.g., travel mode, micro-mobility options, accessibility needs, and assistance needs), priorities for the preferences, device information, a user ID and password, and info to support payment transactions, if applicable.

title: payment device information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name payment device info Description Traveler payment info such as card number and previous transactions.

title: fare collection data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name fare collection data Description Fare collection info including the summary of fare system data and financial payment transaction data.

title: fare management information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name fare mgmt info Description Transit fare info and transaction data used to manage transit fare processing.

title: transit vehicle information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit vehicle info Description Information about the transit vehicle route and stops, including current location along the route and next stop.

title: parking information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name parking info Description General parking info and status, including current parking availability, parking pricing, and parking space availability information, including features like number and type of electric charging spots.

title: interactive traveler information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name interactive traveler info Description Traveler info provided in response to a traveler request. The provided info includes traffic and road conditions, advisories, incidents, restrictions, payment information, transit services, parking information, weather information, and other travel-related data updates and confirmations.

title: traveler request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name traveler request Description A request for traveler info including traffic, transit, toll, parking, road weather conditions, event, and passenger rail information. The request identifies the type of information, the area of interest, parameters that are used to prioritize or filter the returned information, and sorting preferences.

title: demand response passenger and use data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name demand response passenger and use data Description Data collected on board a demand response vehicle relating to the picking up and discharging of passengers.

title: transit vehicle location data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit vehicle location data Description Current transit vehicle location and related operational conditions data provided by a transit vehicle.

title: transit stop request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit stop request Description Notification that a transit stop has been requested by a transit user at a roadside stop. This flow identifies the route, stop, and the time of the request.

title: transit service information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit service info Description Transit service info including routes, schedules, and fare info as well as dynamic transit schedule adherence and transit vehicle location information.

title: alternate mode information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name alternate mode info Description Schedule info for alternate mode transportation providers such as air, ferry, and passenger-carrying heavy rail. This also includes details of incidents and other service disruptions that have occurred in the alternative mode. This also includes measures of service demand that supports assessment of their impact on the road network.

title: traveler information for media
content: Flow Overview Flow Name traveler info for media Description General traveler info regarding incidents, unusual traffic conditions, transit issues, or other advisory info that has been desensitized and provided to the media.

title: vehicle situation data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name vehicle situation data Description This flow represents vehicle snapshots that may be provided by the vehicle to support traffic and environmental conditions monitoring. Snapshots are collected by the vehicle for specific events (e.g., when a sensor exceeds a threshold) or periodically and reported based on control parameters when communications is available. Traffic-related data includes snapshots of measured speed and heading and events including starts and stops, speed changes, and other vehicle control events. Environmental data may include measured air temperature, exterior light status, wiper status, sun sensor status, rain sensor status, traction control status, anti-lock brake status, and other collected vehicle system status and sensor information. The collected data is reported along with the location, heading, and time that the data was collected.

title: vehicle situation data parameters
content: Flow Overview Flow Name vehicle situation data parameters Description A request for vehicle situation data that includes parameters used to control the data that is reported and the flow of data reported by the vehicle. This flow identifies the type of data/snapshots that are requested and reporting parameters such as snapshot frequency, filtering criteria (data thresholds for reporting), and reporting interval.

title: parking availability
content: Flow Overview Flow Name parking availability Description Information on available parking. This flow identifies available spaces with associated info about parking restrictions and location for each available space. Specifically includes info on parking for commercial vehicles, coaches/buses, and cars - and likely also motorcycles, electric vehicle plugins, etc.

title: intersection control status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name intersection control status Description Status data provided by the traffic signal controller including phase information, alarm status, and priority/preempt status.

title: border wait times data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name border wait times data Description Measure of current, actual, or predicted wait time at border. Measurement provided by vehicle type, lane, and type of lane (e.g., NEXUS vs. regular).

title: border crossing status information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name border crossing status info Description Port of entry status including current wait-times, lane configuration and status including closures and restrictions, and notification of incidents at the border

title: tag data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name tag data Description Unique tag ID and related vehicle information.

title: clearance notification
content: Flow Overview Flow Name clearance notification Description Notification that cargo has been cleared through customs.

title: request tag data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name request tag data Description Request for tag info including tag id and associated data.

title: manifest data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name manifest data Description Identifies Port of Entry, date, and info on carrier and goods, origin, etc.

title: freight-specific traveler information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name freight-specific traveler info Description Traveler info customized for freight users to indicate truck routes, permit information, truck stops, inspection stations, steep grades, high-profile vehicle advisories, etc. Information provided includes freight-related road and weather conditions, parking information, and route plans.

title: freight traveler information preferences
content: Flow Overview Flow Name freight traveler info preferences Description Traveler info preferences from fleet and freight mgmt systems or commercial vehicle drivers including: area covered by fleet/driver, types of freight managed (including special restrictions), preferred routes, other travel preferences pertaining to trip costs or tolls. Also covers revised trip planning requirements for trips already underway.

title: on-board safety data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name on-board safety data Description Safety data measured by on-board sensors. Includes info about the vehicle, vehicle components, cargo, and driver. The query flow is not explicitly shown.

title: pass/pull-in
content: Flow Overview Flow Name pass/pull-in Description Command to commercial vehicle to pull into or bypass inspection station.

title: safety inspection record
content: Flow Overview Flow Name safety inspection record Description Record containing results of commercial vehicle safety inspection.

title: citation
content: Flow Overview Flow Name citation Description Report of commercial vehicle citation. The citation includes references to the statute(s) that was (were) violated. It includes info on the violator and the officer issuing the citation. A citation differs from a violation because it is adjudicated by the courts. The info may be provided as a response to a real-time query or proactively by the source. The query flow is not explicitly shown.

title: commercial vehicle violation notification
content: Flow Overview Flow Name commercial vehicle violation notification Description Notification of a violation. The violation notification flow describes the statute or regulation that was violated and how it was violated (e. g., overweight on specific axle by xxx pounds or which brake was out of adjustment and how far out of adjustment it was). A violation differs from a citation because it is not adjudicated by the courts. It specifically includes the date/time and location of the violation and identification of the vehicle, driver, and associated equipment/cargo.

title: daily site activity data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name daily site activity data Description Record of daily activities at commercial vehicle check stations including summaries of screening events and inspections.

title: safety status information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name safety status info Description Safety info such as safety ratings, security ratings or flags, inspection summaries, and violation summaries. A unique identifier is included. Corresponds to the safety and security portion of CVISN "snapshots." The status info may be provided as a response to a real-time query or as a result of a standing request for updated info (subscription). This may also include info about non-U.S. fleets for use by U.S. authorities, and info regarding U.S. fleets made available to Mexican and Canadian authorities. The query flow is not explicitly shown.

title: credentials information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name credentials info Description Response containing full vehicle fuel tax and registration credentials information. "Response" may be provided in reaction to a real-time query or a standing request for updated information. The query flow is not explicitly shown.

title: credentials status information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name credentials status info Description Credentials info such as registration, licensing, insurance, check flags, and electronic screening enrollment data. A unique identifier is included. Corresponds to the credentials portion of CVISN "snapshots." The status info may be provided as a response to a real-time query or as a result of a standing request for updated info (subscription). This may also include info about non-U.S. fleets for use by U.S. authorities, and info regarding U.S. fleets made available to Mexican and Canadian authorities. The query flow is not explicitly shown.

title: cv driver record
content: Flow Overview Flow Name cv driver record Description Information typically maintained by a state driver licensing agency about a driver of a commercial vehicle including driver identification data, license data, permit data, and driving history details. The query flow is not explicitly shown.

title: screening event record
content: Flow Overview Flow Name screening event record Description Results of CVO electronic screening activity.

title: electronic screening request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name electronic screening request Description Request for identification data to support electronic screening.

title: equipment maintenance status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name equipment maintenance status Description Current status of field equipment maintenance actions.

title: maint and constr dispatch information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name maint and constr dispatch info Description Information used to dispatch maintenance and construction vehicles, equipment, and crews and info used to keep work zone crews informed. This info includes routing information, traffic information, road restrictions, incident information, environmental information, decision support information, maintenance schedule data, dispatch instructions, personnel assignments, alert notifications, and corrective actions.

title: maint and constr vehicle system control
content: Flow Overview Flow Name maint and constr vehicle system control Description Configure and control data that supports remote control of on-board maintenance and construction vehicle systems and field equipment that is remotely controlled by the vehicle. For example, the data can be used to adjust material application rates and spread patterns.

title: maint and constr dispatch status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name maint and constr dispatch status Description Current maintenance and construction status including work data, operator status, crew status, and equipment status.

title: maint and constr vehicle operational data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name maint and constr vehicle operational data Description Data that describes the maintenance and construction activity performed by the vehicle. Operational data includes materials usage (amount stored and current application rate), operational state of the maintenance equipment (e.g., blade up/down, spreader pattern), vehicle safety status, and other measures associated with the operation of a maintenance, construction, or other special purpose vehicle. Operational data may include basic operational status of the vehicle equipment or a more precise record of the work performed (e.g., application of crack sealant with precise locations and application characteristics).

title: alternate mode service data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name alternate mode service data Description Detailed real-time schedule and other service info from alternate modes that supports coordination between modes to facilitate efficient transfer at connection points.

title: archive status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name archive status Description Notification that data provided to an archive contains erroneous, missing, or suspicious data or verification that the data provided appears valid. If an error has been detected, the offending data and the nature of the potential problem are identified.

title: archived data product requests
content: Flow Overview Flow Name archived data product requests Description A user-specified request for archived data products (i.e., data, meta data, or data catalogs). The request also includes info that is used to identify and authenticate the user and support electronic payment requirements, if any.

title: archive analysis requests
content: Flow Overview Flow Name archive analysis requests Description A user request that initiates data mining, analytical processing, aggregation or summarization, report formulation, or other advanced processing and analysis of archived data. The request also includes info that is used to identify and authenticate the user and support electronic payment requirements, if any.

title: archived data products
content: Flow Overview Flow Name archived data products Description Raw or processed data, meta data, data catalogs and other data products provided to a user system upon request. The response may also include any associated transaction information.

title: archive request confirmation
content: Flow Overview Flow Name archive request confirmation Description Confirmation that an archive request has been received and processed with info on the disposition of the request.

title: archive analysis results
content: Flow Overview Flow Name archive analysis results Description Processed info products, supporting meta data, and any associated transaction info resulting from data mining, analytical processing, aggregation or summarization, report formulation, or other on-line processing and analysis of archived data.

title: on-board vehicle data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name on-board vehicle data Description Information about the commercial vehicle stored on-board (for maintenance purposes, gate access, cargo status, lock status, etc.). The request flow is not explicitly shown.

title: route restrictions
content: Flow Overview Flow Name route restrictions Description Information about routes, road segments, and areas that do not allow the transport of security sensitive hazmat cargoes or include other restrictions (such as height or weight limits).

title: transit alternate mode information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit alternate mode info Description Transit schedule info provided for coordination at transit interchange points with alternate modes.

title: transit service coordination
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit service coordination Description Schedule coordination or AVL info shared between local/regional transit organizations. This includes coordination of connections and control parameters between transit properties as well as coordination of transit-related maintenance activities.

title: transit traveler information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit traveler info Description Transit info prepared to support transit users and other travelers. It contains transit schedules, real-time arrival information, fare schedules, alerts and advisories, and general transit service information.

title: commercial vehicle trip information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name commercial vehicle trip info Description Information about vehicle trips including load information, location, speed, and routing. The info would be sanitized for distribution outside of the commercial vehicle company.

title: vehicle payment update
content: Flow Overview Flow Name vehicle payment update Description Data written to vehicle equipment to support electronic toll collection or parking payment.

title: transit traveler request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit traveler request Description Request by a Transit traveler to summon assistance, request transit information, or request any other transit services.

title: commercial vehicle permit
content: Flow Overview Flow Name commercial vehicle permit Description Commercial vehicle permits including those for oversize, overweight, or hazmat shipments.

title: transit user information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit user info Description Information about individual transit users boarding a transit vehicle, used to track a user`s progress on a scheduled transit trip.

title: lane closure information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name lane closure info Description Lane closure info provided to passing vehicles. This flow provides info about roadway configuration changes such as lane closures and shifts.

title: conflict monitor status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name conflict monitor status Description A control flow that supports failsafe operation in the event that a conflict is detected that requires the RSE to enter a failsafe operating mode for intersection management. Analogous to a traffic signal conflict monitor, this flow is issued when differences are detected between info provided to the vehicle for in-vehicle display and info displayed by field devices. It contains the details of differences that were found.

title: transit vehicle operator information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit vehicle operator info Description Transit service instructions, wide area alerts, traffic information, road conditions, and other info for both transit and paratransit operators.

title: accident report
content: Flow Overview Flow Name accident report Description Report of commercial vehicle safety accident. The info may be provided as a response to a real-time query or proactively by the source. The query flow is not explicitly shown.

title: alarm acknowledge
content: Flow Overview Flow Name alarm acknowledge Description Confirmation that alarm was received, instructions and additional info for the alarm initiator, and requests for additional information.

title: alarm notification
content: Flow Overview Flow Name alarm notification Description Notification of activation of an audible or silent alarm by a traveler in a public area or by a transit vehicle operator using an on-board device.

title: alert notification
content: Flow Overview Flow Name alert notification Description Notification of a major emergency such as a natural or man-made disaster, civil emergency, or child abduction for distribution to the public. The flow identifies the alert originator, the nature of the emergency, the geographic area affected by the emergency, the effective time period, and info and instructions necessary for the public to respond to the alert. This flow may also identify specific info that should not be released to the public.

title: alert notification coordination
content: Flow Overview Flow Name alert notification coordination Description Coordination of emergency alerts to be distributed to the public. This includes notification of a major emergency such as a natural or man-made disaster, civil emergency, or child abduction for distribution to the public and status of the public notification.

title: alert status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name alert status Description Information indicating the current status of the emergency alert including identification of the traveler and driver info systems that are being used to provide the alert.

title: alerts and advisories
content: Flow Overview Flow Name alerts and advisories Description Assessments (general incident and vulnerability awareness information), advisories (identification of threats or recommendations to increase preparedness levels), and alerts (information on imminent or in-progress emergencies). This flow also provides supporting descriptive detail on incidents, threats, and vulnerabilities to increase preparedness and support effective response to threats against the surface transportation system.

title: archive coordination
content: Flow Overview Flow Name archive coordination Description Catalog data, meta data, published data, and other info exchanged between archives to support data synchronization and satisfy user data requests.

title: asset inventory
content: Flow Overview Flow Name asset inventory Description Information on pavement, bridges, signs and other assets. This includes asset location, installation information, materials information, vendor/contractor information, current maintenance status, and a variety of other info (e.g., video logs) that define the transportation infrastructure.

title: asset status update
content: Flow Overview Flow Name asset status update Description Changes to status of pavement, bridges, signs and other assets resulting from maintenance or construction activities or infrastructure monitoring. The updates may include changes in installation information, materials information, vendor/contractor information, condition, and current maintenance status. In addition to infrastructure asset updates, the info provided may also include status of the maintenance and construction support assets, including vehicle and equipment utilization and repair records.

title: audit data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name audit data Description Information to support a tax audit.

title: barrier system control
content: Flow Overview Flow Name barrier system control Description Information used to configure and control barrier systems that are represented by gates, barriers and other automated or remotely controlled systems used to manage entry to roadways.

title: trip plan
content: Flow Overview Flow Name trip plan Description A travel itinerary covering single or multimodal travel. The itinerary identifies a route and associated traveler info and instructions identifying recommended trip modes (including indoor and outdoor wayfinding) and transfer information, ride sharing options, and transit and parking reservation information.  This flow also includes intermediate info that is provided as the trip plan is interactively created, including identification of alternatives, requests for additional info as well as amenities along the trip.

title: barrier system status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name barrier system status Description Current operating status of barrier systems. Barrier systems represent gates, barriers and other automated or remotely controlled systems used to manage entry to roadways. Status of the systems includes operating condition and current operational state.

title: transit vehicle schedule performance
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit vehicle schedule performance Description Estimated times of arrival and anticipated schedule deviations reported by a transit vehicle.

title: client verification information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name client verification info Description Information about carriers who have made border credential applications such as commercial drivers license info and carrier safety status.

title: client verification request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name client verification request Description Request for info such as commercial drivers license info and carrier safety status.

title: commercial vehicle archive data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name commercial vehicle archive data Description Information describing commercial vehicle travel and commodity flow characteristics. Content may include a catalog of available information, the actual info to be archived, and associated meta data that describes the archived information.

title: commercial vehicle permit information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name commercial vehicle permit info Description Information for commercial vehicle permits for oversize, overweight, or for dangerous goods. The query flow is not explicitly shown.

title: credential application
content: Flow Overview Flow Name credential application Description Application for commercial vehicle credentials. Authorization for payment is included. It contains details about the administrative request for a Freight Vehicle registration. It also carries the acknowledgement that a payment has been placed in the bank account of the administration by the Fleet Operator.  This info flow includes fleet operator request ID, vehicle characteristics, transport need (origin and destination), electronic signature and date of payment.

title: cv repair status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name cv repair status Description Information about the completion of a repair to a commercial vehicle.

title: data collection and monitoring control
content: Flow Overview Flow Name data collection and monitoring control Description Information used to configure and control data collection and monitoring systems.

title: emergency archive data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name emergency archive data Description Logged emergency info including info that characterizes identified incidents (routine highway incidents through disasters), corresponding incident response information, evacuation information, surveillance data, threat data, and resource information. Content may include a catalog of available information, the actual info to be archived, and associated meta data that describes the archived information.

title: environmental conditions data status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name environmental conditions data status Description Status of the data quality of environmental conditions data provided by a data contributor. Includes not only status by sensor, but statistical data regarding the quality checking of data provided.

title: expedited clearance information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name expedited clearance info Description Includes carrier ID, importer ID, broker ID, conveyance ID, driver ID, service options, and associated info that is used to support expedited border clearance.

title: expedited clearance registration
content: Flow Overview Flow Name expedited clearance registration Description Registration of the importer, carrier, conveyance, and driver, as applicable, for border clearance programs such as FAST, Customs Self Assessment (Canada), C-TPAT (US), PIP (Canada), ACI (Canada), and ACE (US). Includes electronic filing of forms and associated payment.

title: expedited clearance status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name expedited clearance status Description Status of expedited clearance registration.

title: rail crossing advisories
content: Flow Overview Flow Name rail crossing advisories Description Notification of Highway-Rail Intersection equipment failure, intersection blockage, or other condition requiring attention, and maintenance activities at or near highway rail intersections.

title: incident command information coordination
content: Flow Overview Flow Name incident command info coordination Description Information that supports local mgmt of an incident. It includes resource deployment status, hazardous material information, traffic, road, and weather conditions, evacuation advice, and other info that enables emergency or maintenance personnel in the field to implement an effective, safe incident response.

title: incident response coordination
content: Flow Overview Flow Name incident response coordination Description Incident response procedures and current incident response status that are shared between allied response agencies to support a coordinated response to incidents. This flow provides current situation information, including a summary of incident status and its impact on the transportation system and other infrastructure, and current and planned response activities. This flow also coordinates a positive hand off of responsibility for all or part of an incident response between agencies.

title: incident response status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name incident response status Description Status of the current incident response including a summary of incident status and its impact on the transportation system, traffic mgmt strategies implemented at the site (e.g., closures, diversions, traffic signal control overrides), and current and planned response activities.

title: infrastructure monitoring sensor control
content: Flow Overview Flow Name infrastructure monitoring sensor control Description Data used to configure and control infrastructure monitoring sensors.

title: infrastructure monitoring sensor data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name infrastructure monitoring sensor data Description Data read from infrastructure-based sensors that monitor the condition or integrity of transportation infrastructure including bridges, tunnels, interchanges, pavement, culverts, signs, transit rail or guideway, and other roadway infrastructure. Includes sensor data and the operational status of the sensors.

title: maint and constr resource request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name maint and constr resource request Description Request for road maintenance and construction resources that can be used in the diversion of traffic (cones, portable signs), clearance of a road hazard, repair of ancillary damage, or any other incident response. The request may poll for resource availability or request pre-staging, staging, or immediate dispatch of resources.

title: maint and constr resource response
content: Flow Overview Flow Name maint and constr resource response Description Current status of maintenance and construction resources including availability and deployment status. General resource inventory info covering vehicles, equipment, materials, and people and specific resource deployment status may be included.

title: maint and constr vehicle conditions
content: Flow Overview Flow Name maint and constr vehicle conditions Description Vehicle diagnostics info that is collected, filtered, and selectively reported by a maintenance and construction vehicle. The info includes engine temperature, mileage, tire wear, brake wear, belt wear, and any warnings or alarms concerning the operational condition of the vehicle and ancillary equipment.

title: maint and constr vehicle location data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name maint and constr vehicle location data Description The current location and related status (e.g., direction and speed) of the maintenance/construction vehicle.

title: maintenance and repair needs
content: Flow Overview Flow Name maintenance and repair needs Description Recommended strategies and schedules for maintenance of the transportation infrastructure.

title: manifest receipt confirmation
content: Flow Overview Flow Name manifest receipt confirmation Description Confirmation that a shippers manifest has been received.

title: vehicle location and motion
content: Flow Overview Flow Name vehicle location and motion Description Data describing the vehicle`s location in three dimensions, heading, speed, acceleration, braking status, and size.

title: qualified environmental conditions data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name qualified environmental conditions data Description Current road conditions (e.g., surface temperature, subsurface temperature, moisture, icing, treatment status) and surface weather conditions (e.g., air temperature, wind speed, precipitation, visibility) that has had quality checks performed on it and has been formatted and consolidated by the Clarus system. Attributes relating to the data collection (and aggregation) are also included.

title: railroad advisories
content: Flow Overview Flow Name railroad advisories Description Real-time notification of railway-related incident or advisory.

title: railroad schedules
content: Flow Overview Flow Name railroad schedules Description Train schedules, maintenance schedules, and other info from the railroad that supports forecast of HRI closures.

title: request for permit
content: Flow Overview Flow Name request for permit Description Request for commercial vehicle permits including oversize, overweight, or hazmat permit. It contains details about the administrative request for conveying hazardous goods. This info flow identifies the freight operator, vehicle dimensions, vehicle weight, hazardous goods characteristics, transport need (origin and destination) and electronic signature.

title: resource deployment status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name resource deployment status Description Status of resource deployment identifying the resources (vehicles, equipment, materials, and personnel) available and their current status. General resource inventory info and specific status of deployed resources may be included.

title: resource request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name resource request Description A request for resources to implement special traffic control measures, assist in clean up, verify an incident, etc. The request may poll for resource availability or request pre-staging, staging, or immediate deployment of resources. Resources may be explicitly requested or a service may be requested and the specific resource deployment may be determined by the responding agency.

title: road network traffic situation data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name road network traffic situation data Description Aggregated route usage, travel times, and other aggregated data collected from probe vehicles that can be used to estimate current traffic conditions.

title: roadside archive data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name roadside archive data Description A broad set of data derived from roadside sensors that includes current traffic conditions, environmental conditions, and any other data that can be directly collected by roadside sensors. This data also indicates the status of the sensors and reports of any identified sensor faults.

title: roadway treatment system control
content: Flow Overview Flow Name roadway treatment system control Description Control data for remotely located, automated devices, that treat the road surface (e.g., de-icing applications).

title: roadway treatment system status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name roadway treatment system status Description Current operational status of automated roadway treatment devices (e.g., anti-icing systems).

title: safety inspection report
content: Flow Overview Flow Name safety inspection report Description Report containing results of commercial vehicle safety inspection. The info may be provided as a response to a real-time query or proactively by the source. The query flow is not explicitly shown.

title: safety inspection request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name safety inspection request Description Request for safety inspection record.

title: secure area sensor control
content: Flow Overview Flow Name secure area sensor control Description Information used to configure and control threat sensors (e.g., thermal, acoustic, radiological, chemical), object, motion and intrusion detection sensors. The provided info controls sensor data collection, aggregation, filtering, and other local processing.

title: secure area sensor data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name secure area sensor data Description Data provided by threat sensors (e.g., thermal, acoustic, radiological, chemical), and intrusion, motion, and object detection sensors in secure areas indicating the sensor`s operational status, raw and processed sensor data, and alarm indicators when a threat has been detected.

title: secure area surveillance control
content: Flow Overview Flow Name secure area surveillance control Description Information used to configure and control audio and video surveillance systems used for transportation infrastructure security in secure areas. The provided info controls surveillance data collection, aggregation, filtering, and other local processing.

title: secure area surveillance data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name secure area surveillance data Description Data collected from surveillance systems used to monitor secure areas. Includes video, audio, processed surveillance data, equipment operational status, and alarm indicators when a threat has been detected.

title: shoulder management control
content: Flow Overview Flow Name shoulder mgmt control Description Information used to configure and control systems that allow use of a shoulder as a lane for vehicular traffic.

title: shoulder management information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name shoulder mgmt info Description System status including current operational state, violations and logged information.

title: signal fault data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name signal fault data Description Faults reported by traffic signal control equipment.

title: tax filing
content: Flow Overview Flow Name tax filing Description Commercial vehicle tax filing data. Authorization for payment is included.

title: threat information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name threat info Description Threats regarding transportation infrastructure, facilities, or systems detected by a variety of methods (sensors, surveillance, threat analysis of advisories from outside agencies, etc.

title: threat information coordination
content: Flow Overview Flow Name threat info coordination Description Sensor, surveillance, and threat data including raw and processed data that is collected by sensor and surveillance equipment located in secure areas.

title: traffic information for media
content: Flow Overview Flow Name traffic info for media Description Report of traffic conditions including traffic incident reports for public dissemination through the media.  The reports may also include info on diversions and alternate routes, closures, and special traffic restrictions in effect.

title: transit archive data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit archive data Description Data used to describe and monitor transit demand, fares, operations, and system performance. Content may include a catalog of available information, the actual info to be archived, and associated meta data that describes the archived information.

title: transit emergency data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit emergency data Description Initial notification of transit emergency at a transit stop or on transit vehicles and further coordination as additional details become available and the response is coordinated.

title: transit vehicle conditions
content: Flow Overview Flow Name transit vehicle conditions Description Operating conditions of transit vehicle (e.g., engine running, oil pressure, fuel level and usage).  It includes status of other on-board systems including user displays, passenger counters, and security systems. This overall status info is also collected from unused (out of service) vehicles.

title: travel services information
content: Flow Overview Flow Name travel services info Description Travel service info and reservations for tourist attractions, lodging, dining, service stations, emergency services, and other services and businesses of interest to the traveler.

title: traveler alerts
content: Flow Overview Flow Name traveler alerts Description Traveler info alerts reporting congestion, incidents, adverse road or weather conditions, restrictions, vehicle requirements, parking availability, transit service delays or interruptions, and other info that may impact the traveler. Relevant alerts are provided based on traveler-supplied profile info including trip characteristics and preferences.

title: trip log
content: Flow Overview Flow Name trip log Description Driver`s daily log, vehicle location, mileage, and trip activity (includes screening, inspection and border clearance event data as well as fare payments). The request flow is not explicitly shown.

title: intersection infringement info
content: Flow Overview Flow Name intersection infringement info Description Vehicle path info sent by a vehicle that is performing an unpermitted movement at an intersection such as a stop sign violation or running a red light. This also includes info about possible conflicts with other road users in the vehicle`s path, including a range of uncontrolled intersection scenarios that could be covered by this flow. This flow does not include permanent ids; only temporary ones that allow monitoring of the vehicle as it moves across the intersection.

title: work plan coordination
content: Flow Overview Flow Name work plan coordination Description Coordination of work plan schedules and activities between maintenance and construction organizations or systems. This info includes the work plan schedules and comments and suggested changes that are exchanged as work plans are coordinated and finalized.

title: traffic archive data
content: Flow Overview Flow Name traffic archive data Description Information describing the use and vehicle composition on transportation facilities and the traffic control strategies employed. Content may include a catalog of available information, the actual info to be archived, and associated meta data that describes the archived information.

title: service patrol incident status
content: Flow Overview Flow Name service patrol incident status Description Information gathered at the incident site by a service patrol vehicle that more completely characterizes the incident, the services provided, and clearance status.

title: service patrol dispatch request
content: Flow Overview Flow Name service patrol dispatch request Description Service patrol dispatch instructions including incident location and available info concerning the incident.

title: service patrol dispatch response
content: Flow Overview Flow Name service patrol dispatch response Description Request for additional dispatch info and provision of en route status.

title: reduced speed warning info
content: Flow Overview Flow Name reduced speed warning info Description Real time notification of vehicle detections, measured vehicle characteristics (e.g., vehicle height), speed measurements, and warnings issued by roadway infrastructure. This flow can also include roadway configuration data, current speed limits, and warning parameters and thresholds enabling local speed mgmt application configuration and management.

title: proxied personal location
content: Flow Overview Flow Name proxied personal location Description Relay of pedestrian, bicyclist, and other non-motorized user locations at an intersection. This relay or rebroadcast of personal locations supports coordination between motorized and non-motorized users that do not have interoperable communications capability.

title: Functional Requirements: Vehicle Intersection Warning
content: Functional Requirements: Vehicle Intersection Warning Functional Description: `Vehicle Intersection Warning` uses V2V and V2I communications to monitor other connected vehicles at intersections and support the safe movement of the vehicle through the intersection. Driver warnings are provided and the application may also optionally take control of the vehicle to avoid collisions. The application will also notify the infrastructure and other vehicles if it detects an unsafe infringement on the intersection. Requirements: Vehicle shall provide vehicle path info to identify if vehicle is performing an unpermitted movement at an intersection such as a stop sign violation or running a red light. Vehicle shall provide data describing the vehicle's location in three dimensions, heading, speed, acceleration, braking status, and size. The vehicle shall receive intersection signal timing info in order for the vehicle to determine if it will safely cross the intersection given its current location and speed. The vehicle shall be capable of providing warnings to the driver based upon info received regarding pedestrians, cyclists, and other non-motorized users that are sharing the roadway with the vehicle. The vehicle shall receive warning from the infrastructure if an intersection violation appears to be imminent. The vehicle shall provide to the driver a warning if it looks like the vehicle will go through the intersection after the signal has turned red.

title: Functional Requirements: TIC Travel Services Information and Reservation
content: Functional Requirements: TIC Travel Services Information and Reservation Functional Description: `TIC Travel Services Information` disseminates info about traveler services such as lodging, restaurants, electric vehicle charging, and service stations. Tailored traveler service info is provided on request that meets the constraints and preferences specified by the traveler. This application also supports reservations and advanced payment for traveler services including parking and loading zone use. Requirements: The center shall disseminate yellow pages info (such as lodging, restaurants, theaters, bicycle facilities, and other tourist activities) to travelers upon request. The center shall support yellow pages service info and reservation requests from a kiosk. The center shall support yellow pages service info and reservation requests from a personal device. The center shall support yellow pages service info and reservation requests from a vehicle. The center shall support yellow pages service info and reservation requests from a traveler on-board a transit vehicle. The center shall provide all yellow pages info based on the traveler's current location and filter the provided info accordingly. The center shall manage registration of yellow pages service providers, store provider details, and transact payments for the provider's registration. The center shall manage reservations and payment for yellow pages services and provide transaction success or failure details. The center shall provide electric charging station info identifying the location, operating hours, current availability, charging capacity and standards supported, access restrictions, and rates/fee structure for each station to travelers. The center shall provide charging station info to electric vehicles in order to balance the supply and demand of charging facilities.

title: Functional Requirements: TMC Lighting System Control
content: Functional Requirements: TMC Lighting System Control Functional Description: `TMC Lighting System Control` provides the capability for traffic managers to monitor and manage the electrical lighting systems along the roadside. This capability includes implementing control plans for lighting systems that may be activated by time-of-day plans or by activating changes to the lighting based on traffic or incidents. Requirements: The traffic mgmt center shall remotely control electrical lighting systems. The traffic mgmt center shall collect lighting system operational status from the field and compare against the control info sent by the center. The traffic mgmt center shall collect lighting system fault data from the field and send to the maintenance center for repair. The traffic mgmt center shall receive the environmental data collected from connected vehicle. The traffic mgmt center shall monitor vehicle presence. The traffic mgmt center shall adjust lighting level based on operational condition.

title: Functional Requirements: Roadway Lighting System Control
content: Functional Requirements: Roadway Lighting System Control Functional Description: `Roadway Lighting System Control` includes field equipment that controls lighting systems for transportation facilities and infrastructure. It includes the sensors, lighting controllers, and supporting field equipment that monitors and controls lighting systems. The equipment supports control based on sensed local conditions, stored timing plans, and remote commands from a center. It monitors lighting system status and reports status to the controlling center. Requirements: The field element shall control lighting systems along the roadside under center control. The field element shall return operational status for the lighting system equipment to the center. The field element shall return lighting system equipment fault data to the center for repair.

title: Functional Requirements: RSE Traffic Monitoring
